{{Top|leg}}
'''Darish Vol's estate''' was a household on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that was home to [[Darish Vol]], the [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. The estate was a lavish monument to his power, with the public rooms speaking subtly of his wealth and fine taste. Although his private rooms were very bare similar to the apprentice quarters of the [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]].<ref name="FOTJ">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
